### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

### Motivation / Problem Statement
Why is this needed? (e.g. research benchmark requirement, real-world fleet constraint, performance improvement).

### Proposed Solution / Mathematical Formulation
Describe the proposed approach, routing formulation, OR-Tools constraints, or API changes.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit/regression tests proving correctness
- [ ] Documented in relevant specs or README
- [ ] Verified with `RouteValidator`
